sampleNims.comment: Made-up sample student numbers used by fixtures and tests. A new one must never be a real member's number, and doesn't belong here: use a sequence of 900 or more (13525901), which no member can hold and the check always allows. The entries below predate the check.

behaviourNims.comment: Student numbers the API itself uses for who may open a form early or apply to SPARTA. They belong to real members, so they are kept only as SHA-256 hashes and may appear only in the files listed here. Delete this list when the numbers leave the code.

sampleTables.comment: Tracked tables that have a name column beside a student-number or email column. Each holds only made-up rows; every number in them must also be a sample number above. A new member list must never be added.
